# Rojas Photography

> Premium corporate photography and video studio in Modesto, CA, owned and run by husband-and-wife team Alfonso and Niomi Rojas — two photographers on every session. Specializing in executive headshots, on-site team headshot days, headshot booths, conference and corporate event photography, commercial photography, and video production across the Central Valley and California.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Rojas Photography
- **Owners & Photographers:** Alfonso and Niomi Rojas (they photograph every session together)
- **Location:** Modesto, CA 95356 (Central Valley, California)
- **Phone:** 209-380-3727
- **Email:** alfonso@rojasphotography.net
- **Website:** https://rojasphotography.net

## Services

- [Premium Studio Headshots](https://rojasphotography.net/premium-headshots): Individual headshot sessions at the Modesto studio. $150 session fee + $150 per selected image, no minimum purchase. Unlimited wardrobe changes and real-time guided posing. Clients review and select their favorite images in the studio during the session; finished, hand-retouched images are delivered by email within 48 hours.
- [On-Site Team Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/on-site-photography): Alfonso and Niomi bring a complete professional studio to your office, medical facility, or business. Priced at $150 per person with no minimum, with individual coaching for each team member and same-day gallery delivery. For large teams they can run multiple headshot stations or multi-day schedules.
- [Annual Headshot Programs](https://rojasphotography.net/annual-headshot-programs): Recurring corporate headshot programs that keep a company's team photos current year after year — ideal for organizations with regular new hires.
- [Headshot Booth](https://rojasphotography.net/headshot-booth): High-volume headshot station for expos, conferences, training days, and corporate events. Attendees are coached through a quick session and the edited gallery is delivered the same day. A half day (4 hours) starts at $2,500 and a full day is $5,000, with unlimited attendees.
- [Corporate Event Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/event-photography): Conferences, galas, fundraisers, and corporate gatherings, covered statewide — including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, and San Diego. Standard delivery is a fully edited gallery within 5–7 business days. A premium real-time add-on (SpotMyPhotos face recognition) sends attendees their own photos within seconds of capture, with a custom branded landing page featuring sponsor logos. Trusted by Comcast, Save Mart, the California Lawyers Association, and Valley First Credit Union.
- [Conference Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/conference-photography): Coordinated multi-photographer coverage for conferences, annual meetings, and multi-day events — keynotes, breakout sessions, the expo floor, and networking. Optional attendee headshot station and highlight video. Based in Modesto with statewide coverage — Sacramento, the Bay Area, Los Angeles, and San Diego; trusted by the California Lawyers Association for their Annual Meeting.
- [Commercial Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/commercial): Brand imagery, facility photography, product shots, and marketing visuals for Central Valley businesses. Delivery within 5–7 business days.
- [Video Production](https://rojasphotography.net/video): Three corporate video services — brand and story films (company overviews, client testimonials, recruiting and culture videos), event video coverage (conference and gala highlight reels), and social media reels — plus FAA Part 107 certified drone footage. Every production is led by Alfonso and Niomi Rojas, with a trusted crew added when a project calls for it. Short videos deliver in 1–2 weeks; full productions in 3–4 weeks.

## Credentials and Trust Signals

- Two photographers (Alfonso and Niomi) on every session — a premium differentiator
- 500+ professionals photographed across the Central Valley
- 70 five-star Google reviews (5.0 rating)
- 15+ years of corporate leadership experience and 15+ years of photography experience
- FAA Part 107 certified for commercial drone operations, insured
- Clients include: Save Mart, Comcast, Kaiser, Tenet Health, California Lawyers Association (CLA), Valley First Credit Union, BBSI, Stanislaus County organizations
- Based in Modesto, CA, serving clients statewide

## Pricing Summary

- Studio headshot session fee: $150
- Per image selected: $150 (no minimum, no package required)
- On-site team photography: $150 per person, no minimum
- Headshot booth: half day (4 hours) starts at $2,500, full day $5,000; unlimited attendees, multi-day events quoted flat
- Event photography: custom quote; a 4-hour event typically runs $1,500–$2,500, a full day $2,500–$4,500 with one photographer
- Conference photography, commercial photography, video production: custom quote within 24 hours

## Service Area

Primary: Modesto, CA
Also serves: Stockton, Turlock, Fresno, Sacramento, Merced, Bakersfield, Ceres, Riverbank, Oakdale, Lodi, Tracy, Manteca, Clovis, and the broader Central Valley. Available throughout California — including Sacramento, the Bay Area, Los Angeles, and San Diego — for conferences, events, and on-site engagements.

## About Alfonso and Niomi Rojas

Alfonso and Niomi Rojas are the husband-and-wife owners and photographers of Rojas Photography. They photograph every session together — two photographers on every job. Both come from corporate environments (manufacturing, executive leadership, HR, and operations), so they are comfortable working with marketing teams, CEOs, and CFOs, and they understand how business decisions get made. Alfonso is FAA Part 107 certified for drone operations. They guide every client through posing and expression in real time, which is why even camera-shy professionals come away with headshots they are proud to use.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who are Alfonso and Niomi Rojas?**
Alfonso and Niomi Rojas are the husband-and-wife owners and photographers of Rojas Photography, based in Modesto, CA. They photograph every session together — two photographers on every job. They bring 15+ years of corporate leadership experience, and Alfonso is FAA Part 107 certified for drone operations. Together they have photographed 500+ executives and professionals across the Central Valley and hold 70 five-star Google reviews.

**What does Rojas Photography specialize in?**
Rojas Photography specializes in corporate and professional photography and video — executive headshots, on-site team photography, headshot booth events, conference and corporate event coverage, commercial photography, and video production. All services are available in Modesto and throughout the Central Valley, with conference and event coverage statewide.

**How much does a headshot cost at Rojas Photography?**
A professional headshot session at Rojas Photography costs $150 for the session, plus $150 per image selected. There is no minimum number of images to purchase. For on-site team photography, headshot booths, events, and commercial projects, pricing is customized based on scope.

**How fast are photos delivered?**
Studio headshot clients select their images in the studio and receive finished, retouched files by email within 48 hours. On-site team headshot days and headshot booths include same-day gallery delivery. Event and conference galleries are delivered within 5–7 business days, with an optional real-time delivery add-on that sends attendees their photos during the event.

**Where is Rojas Photography located?**
Rojas Photography is based in Modesto, CA 95356. The studio serves clients in Modesto, Stockton, Turlock, Fresno, Sacramento, Merced, Bakersfield, and throughout the Central Valley. On-site photography is available at client locations throughout California.

**Is Rojas Photography available for events outside of Modesto?**
Yes. Alfonso and Niomi travel throughout California for on-site team photography, headshot booth events, commercial shoots, conferences, and event photography — they have photographed conferences in San Francisco and Newport Beach and cover corporate events in Los Angeles and San Diego. Every engagement gets one clear, personalized quote based on location and scope.
